```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ---- 1) Read substitution table from file ----
df <- read.delim(
  "01.SNV_frequency_4groups.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ---- 2) Compute total across all groups per type and reorder ----
df <- df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total = sum(c_across(-type))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Reorder types based on total descending
subs_order <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(type)

# ---- 3) Reshape + set factor levels ----
custom_colors <- c(
  "M_H_C_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "M_H_C_L" = "#65C9F3C9",
  "M_L_C_H" = "#F3E065",
  "M_L_C_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)

df_long <- df %>%
  select(-total) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -type,
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Frequency"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = names(custom_colors)),
    type = factor(type, levels = subs_order)
  )

# ---- 4) Plot ----
p_ranked <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(x = type, y = Frequency, fill = Group)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Substitution Frequencies per Group (Ranked by Total)",
    x = "Substitution Type (Sorted by Total)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey95",
      color = "grey80"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

print(p_ranked)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# ============================
# 1) Read Data
# ============================
df <- read.delim(
  "01.Mutation_CPD_overlap_4groups.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Your file contains:
# Group
# Cluster_Number
# Unique_Mutation_Sites
# Mutation_CPD_Overlap
# Overlap_Percent

# Convert percentage to ratio for donut plotting
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Overlap = Overlap_Percent / 100,
    NonOverlap = 1 - Overlap
  )

# ============================
# 2) Colors
# ============================
group_colors <- c(
  "M_H_C_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "M_H_C_L" = "#65C9F3",
  "M_L_C_H" = "#F3E065",
  "M_L_C_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)

# ============================
# 3) Donut Function
# ============================
make_donut <- function(group_name, overlap, nonoverlap, color) {

  data <- data.frame(
    Part = c("Overlap", "NonOverlap"),
    Ratio = c(overlap, nonoverlap)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(
        Part == "Overlap",
        sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * Ratio),
        ""
      )
    )

  ggplot(data, aes(x = 2, y = Ratio, fill = Part)) +
    geom_col(
      width = 1,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Overlap" = unname(color),
        "NonOverlap" = alpha(unname(color), 0.3)
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    labs(title = group_name) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ============================
# 4) Create Four Donuts
# ============================
p1 <- make_donut(
  "M_H_C_H",
  df$Overlap[df$Group == "M_H_C_H"],
  df$NonOverlap[df$Group == "M_H_C_H"],
  group_colors["M_H_C_H"]
)

p2 <- make_donut(
  "M_H_C_L",
  df$Overlap[df$Group == "M_H_C_L"],
  df$NonOverlap[df$Group == "M_H_C_L"],
  group_colors["M_H_C_L"]
)

p3 <- make_donut(
  "M_L_C_H",
  df$Overlap[df$Group == "M_L_C_H"],
  df$NonOverlap[df$Group == "M_L_C_H"],
  group_colors["M_L_C_H"]
)

p4 <- make_donut(
  "M_L_C_L",
  df$Overlap[df$Group == "M_L_C_L"],
  df$NonOverlap[df$Group == "M_L_C_L"],
  group_colors["M_L_C_L"]
)

# ============================
# 5) Arrange in 2 x 2 Grid
# ============================
final_plot <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Mutation-CPD Overlap Ratio per Group"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  )

print(final_plot)
```



#ALL
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# ============================
# 1) Read Data
# ============================
df <- read.delim(
  "01.Mutation_CPD_overlap_4groups.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ============================
# 2) Donut Function
# ============================
make_donut <- function(group_name, overlap, nonoverlap, color) {
  
  data <- data.frame(
    Part = c("Overlap", "NonOverlap"),
    Ratio = c(overlap, nonoverlap)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(
        Part == "Overlap",
        sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * Ratio),
        ""
      )
    )

  ggplot(data, aes(x = 2, y = Ratio, fill = Part)) +
    geom_col(
      width = 1,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Overlap" = unname(color),
        "NonOverlap" = alpha(unname(color), 0.3)
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    labs(title = group_name) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ============================
# 3) Overall Overlap Calculation
# ============================
overlap_count <- sum(df$Mutation_CPD_Overlap)
total_count   <- sum(df$Unique_Mutation_Sites)

overlap_ratio <- overlap_count / total_count
nonoverlap_ratio <- 1 - overlap_ratio

# Check values
cat("Total mutation sites:", total_count, "\n")
cat("Total overlap sites:", overlap_count, "\n")
cat("Overall overlap ratio:", overlap_ratio, "\n")
cat("Overall overlap percent:", overlap_ratio * 100, "%\n")

# ============================
# 4) Set Color
# ============================
my_color <- "#7678ed"

# ============================
# 5) Generate Overall Donut
# ============================
p_overall <- make_donut(
  group_name = "Overall Mutation-CPD Overlap",
  overlap = overlap_ratio,
  nonoverlap = nonoverlap_ratio,
  color = my_color
)

print(p_overall)

```
